sloka: उपसम्पादयामास कौसल्या पमाङ्गना ।उपाध्यायः स विधिना हुत्व शान्तिमनामयम् ॥२-२५-२९॥
transliteration: upasampādayāmāsa kausalyā pamāṅganā ।upādhyāyaḥ sa vidhinā hutva śāntimanāmayam ॥2-25-29॥

translations.english: The officiating priest performed the ritual of sacrificial offerings strictly in accordance with rules for peace and happiness of Rama. With the remainder of the offerings, he performed whatever ceremonies were to be done externally.
